fact: AIM reports that on 22 July 2024 the ministries of Justice and Health launched real-time electronic notification of hospital births into e-SiRCEV, begun April-May 2024 in four Inhambane districts, with families able to register newborns before discharge and extension to all provinces planned gradually.
title: Governo lança Sistema Electrónico de Registo Civil em Unidades Hospitalares
